rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_ai ai_memory and ai_trace tables, then drops ai_trace, ai_memory, prompt_package and the northstar_ai schema (CASCADE). prompt_package holds only immutable prompt configuration and ai_trace holds derived provenance; ai_memory holds user-controlled AI memory, so on a shared environment export ai_memory first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_ai schema with prompt_package, ai_memory and ai_trace tables exists
prompt_package has a composite primary key on (package_id, version) enforcing immutability by identity
row-level security is enabled and forced on ai_memory and ai_trace with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 3 governed AI (gateway + RAG + tool broker) baseline
